text:
alex (eng): Hey team — I need temporary prod-admin access (break-glass) to redact suspected PII in payments logs after a customer report. Goal: find & redact SSNs/credit card fragments in /var/log/redwood/apps/payments and the S3 bucket. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/AR-5421. Asking for ~30m window starting in ~5m. Can someone approve and confirm session recording + bastion usage?

lina (sec): @alex (eng) thanks — quick checklist before approval: 1) add explicit start/end times & justification to the access request, 2) scope the exact paths/buckets, 3) do NOT copy raw logs off-host, 4) enable session recording. Link: https://internal.redwood/docs/redaction-playbook :lock:  

alex (eng): Adding details now. Scope: /var/log/redwood/apps/payments/* and s3://redwood-prod-logs/payments/2026-03-16. Start ~1766504400 (in ~3–5m), TTL 35m. Justification: customer reported exposed PII in payment processor logs; need in-place redaction and verification. Commands I plan to run (on bastion):
```
sudo --session=ephemeral grep -E "(ssn|credit_card|\b\d{4}-\d{4}\b)" /var/log/redwood/apps/payments/* | sed -E 's/([0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4})/REDACTED_SSN/g'
```
I will not persist copies and will redact in-place.

mike (prod-sre): Conditional approve from infra side. Must run from bastion-2, session recording ON, tag session with AR-5421. I can open a JIT window once @jamie (mgr) gives manager sign-off. Also reminder: use the grant-access CLI so we get ephemeral creds.

jamie (mgr): OK from me — approve 35m window. :thumbsup:

lina (sec): I'm good to approve once the access request includes the start/end time and recording requirement. Also: rotate any temporary tokens if you escalate levels, and add a short justification summary in the ticket. I'll monitor the audit feed.

audit-bot: Access request AR-5421 created by alex (eng). Status: pending approval. Required: session recording, JIT bastion, ticket tag. Expires automatically if not approved within 15m.

mike (prod-sre): Granting sudo on bastion-2 for alex (eng) for 35m. Command executed: `grant-access --user alex --host bastion-2 --role prod-admin --ticket AR-5421 --ttl 35m` — session recording enabled.

alex (eng): Got the window; starting in ~2 mins. I will post a concise result summary when finished. Thanks all.

lina (sec): Reminder: redact only what matches the pattern, do not exfiltrate logs, close session immediately when done, and mark AR-5421 with outcome. If you need extra time, request extension in the ticket with justification. :warning:

alex (eng): Done. Summary: found 3 matches in /var/log/redwood/apps/payments/worker.log and one object in S3. Redacted lines and ran a quick verify. Commands run (snippet):
```
# redaction run (in place)
sudo sed -E -i 's/([0-9]{3}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4})/REDACTED_SSN/g' /var/log/redwood/apps/payments/worker.log
# verification
sudo grep -E "(ssn|credit_card)" /var/log/redwood/apps/payments/* || echo "no matches"
```
Closed session and uploaded audit artifacts to secure-audit/AR-5421.

mike (prod-sre): Confirmed session closed; recorded session and logs stored at s3://secure-audit/AR-5421/recording.mp4 and metadata JSON. All good from infra.

jamie (mgr): Thanks — please create a short follow-up in the customer ticket summarizing actions. If customer asks, propose a brief postmortem. :calendar:

alex (eng): Will file follow-up notes in AR-5421 and ping customer ops. Appreciate the quick approvals.
